title: How the region fits together

lanes.name: How the region is organised
lanes.gives: A platform, a brand, rooms, review, and a clock
lanes.gets: Changes that hold up, carried back to the commons

stations.name: The Upskilling Labs, Inc.
stations.note: Holds the brand, the board, the Ambassador program and the national site

stations.name: National OLOS
stations.note: Gives every region the same platform; takes back what they prove

stations.name: The Upskilling Labs of Greater Washington
stations.note: The regional association: its own copy of OLOS, its own site and database, so it can change things without touching national

stations.name: The steering committee
stations.note: Decides what the region becomes and, with the regional association, maintains OLOS, the Upskilling Labs app

stations.name: Pod maintainers
stations.note: Review every pull request so the region stays compatible with national

stations.name: Builders in residence
stations.note: Three to five per pod; each turns a frame into one change

stations.name: Three research pods
stations.note: Scaffolding, Wayfinding, Front Door: each turns a problem into a paradox and frames

stations.name: Projects
stations.note: One change The Labs runs on, built on the region’s OLOS, used by a real person

stations.name: The showcase
stations.note: What held up is offered upstream to national OLOS, as pull requests

stations.name: Employers
stations.note: Not asked yet. What they could read: a record of what you built

lanes.name: Build Cycle C04
lanes.gives: A fixed clock, a room on group days, a vote
lanes.gets: Problems picked, finds, prototypes, three releases

stations.name: Sensemaking day
stations.note: The room picks its problems

stations.name: Archaeology
stations.note: How this became a problem; what’s been tried anywhere

stations.name: First interviews
stations.note: One per builder; the context map drafted

stations.name: The paradox
stations.note: Two truths that block the easy fix; each builder leaves with a frame

stations.name: Rapid prototypes
stations.note: Each a probe, put in front of three real people

stations.name: The room votes
stations.note: Proposals pitched; a yes gives a project a team

stations.name: First release
stations.note: Used by at least three real people

stations.name: Second release
stations.note: Changed by what those people did

stations.name: Final release
stations.note: A January maintainer named; a pull request to OLOS

stations.name: Teach-back
stations.note: The room learns what each team learned

lanes.name: A person’s route
lanes.gives: Four to six volunteer hours a week, and what you already know
lanes.gets: Practice, a team, and a public record of what you built

stations.name: You hear of it
stations.note: A friend, LinkedIn, a Luma listing, the Metro map

stations.name: A first session
stations.note: You leave with a tool learned or a thing made, at a library or online

stations.name: An account on the app
stations.note: A profile that follows you between the parts

stations.name: More sessions
stations.note: Skills, practised: learn a tool, work a problem with others

stations.name: Into a Cycle
stations.note: C04 by invitation to past participants

stations.name: A research pod
stations.note: A question, company, and the archaeology to do

stations.name: A frame
stations.note: A way to see the problem that is yours

stations.name: A prototype
stations.note: Made in an hour; evidence from three people

stations.name: A team
stations.note: A team and a mandate. Or not: if the room doesn’t pick your project, your pod dissolves

stations.name: Three weeks of building
stations.note: A change that ships, used by real people

stations.name: The showcase
stations.note: A public record of what you built, and a team you stay in touch with

stations.name: After
stations.note: Nothing yet. The record counts nowhere; there is no route back in

lanes.name: Where people gather
lanes.gives: Rooms all over the region, hosted by neighbours, run from a kit
lanes.gets: People who know each other, before, between and after Cycles

stations.name: Neighborhood workshops
stations.note: A neighborhood team hosts in person, at their own library, from a kit

stations.name: Salons
stations.note: Small evenings around one question, where past participants meet newcomers

stations.name: Meetups
stations.note: Planned as multi-organization events, co-hosted with civic tech groups, libraries, nonprofits and employers

stations.name: Summits
stations.note: Real DC-style summits: panels, partners, agencies and employers in the room, with the showcase on the program

lanes.name: The commons: OLOS, modules and kits
lanes.gives: An open contribution model: anyone can propose a change
lanes.gets: Kits, modules and code any neighbourhood or region can use

stations.name: Kits
stations.note: Modular programmatic kits: a session in a box, with agenda, materials, facilitator notes and setup

stations.name: Learning modules
stations.note: What a training teaches, written once, taught by any trainer

stations.name: Contributor
stations.note: Opens an issue or a pull request to OLOS, a module or a kit

stations.name: Reviewer
stations.note: Reviews other people’s changes; trusted to say what’s ready

stations.name: Committer
stations.note: Can merge: changes the region runs on

stations.name: Maintainer
stations.note: Keeps a part healthy over time. OLOS itself is maintained by the steering committee and the regional association
